content: python-daemon latest = 3.1.2 (PyPI), PEP 3143 implementation, Apache-2.0 (library) by Ben Finney, copyright 2008-2024, POSIX-only, hosted on pagure.io, slow release cadence. Provides DaemonContext context manager (double-fork, setsid, umask, detach streams). Rejected for SIF: (a) adds a runtime dep to a light pure-Python PyPI package for ~30 lines of stdlib double-fork (os.fork/os.setsid/os.umask + dup2 to /dev/null); (b) daemonizing conflicts with supervisor mode - launchd KeepAlive and systemd Type=simple expect a foreground process that never forks; forking defeats exit-status tracking and restart throttling. Correct split: sif watch stays foreground under launchd/systemd; --detach uses stdlib double-fork only for ad-hoc background runs.
